hero_subtitle: Your trusted beauty tools source factory since 2015
profile_p1: Founded in 2015, AVGM is a professional beauty tools manufacturer and wholesale supplier based in Guangzhou Baiyun, China. With 2 production bases spanning 5,000+ square meters, we specialize in the R&D, manufacturing, and export of nail supplies, eyelash extensions, permanent makeup equipment, beauty devices, daily chemical products, and professional makeup tools.
profile_p2: Over the past 10+ years, we have built a reputation for reliable quality, competitive factory pricing, and exceptional customer service. Our products reach importers, distributors, and salon chains across Africa, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, South America, and Europe.
profile_p3: We don't just sell products — we partner with our clients. From OEM/ODM customization to after-sales support, we are committed to your success in the beauty industry.
mission_desc: To provide beauty professionals worldwide with high-quality, affordable tools and supplies directly from the source factory.
vision_desc: To become the most trusted beauty tools supply chain partner globally.
values_desc: Quality first. Customer success is our success. Long-term partnership over short-term profit.
global_desc: Our products reach 60+ countries across 4 continents.
